observation: The laptop link flapped within a two-minute window on 2026-08-04.

timeline.evidence: ping and ssh both timed out across repeated retries over ~9h
tailscale showed direct connection 42.114.218.147:21705; ssh returned 'up'; message delivered and confirmed by directory listing
3 consecutive ssh timeouts; tailscale reports 'relay "sin"; offline, tx 2652 rx 0'

consequence: The mailbox is a real channel but not a reliable one. Anything that matters must be durable on disk in the repo first and sent opportunistically second — which is how the five decisions were handled, and why the send succeeded despite a window of only a few minutes.
what_this_does_not_change: The message was delivered and confirmed present before the link dropped. Nothing needs resending.
